shared_elements: figure holding a staff-like or rod-like object in one hand
low-relief figures aligned along a single register with feet on a groundline
justification: Both show bearded male figures in strict profile, in shallow relief, wearing long detailed garments and grasping a rod/staff-like object, rendered with the same conventions of patterned hair and beard and a firm groundline. But the depicted subjects diverge sharply: A is a single large winged supernatural figure with raised hand and no companions or borders, while B is a multi-figure procession leading a two-humped camel, framed above and below by continuous rosette bands.
